title: JavaScript Programming
description: Modern JavaScript reference covering values, scope, objects, collections, functions, modules, promises, iterators, browser APIs, performance, testing, and security.

subtopics.title: Types, Coercion & Equality
subtopics.description: JavaScript has primitive values and objects. Prefer strict equality, explicit conversion, nullish coalescing, and optional chaining at uncertain boundaries.

callouts.title: const Does Not Freeze Objects
callouts.text: const prevents rebinding. Use immutable update discipline or Object.freeze for shallow runtime protection.

subtopics.title: Objects, Arrays, Map & Set
subtopics.description: Objects are record-like property bags; arrays are indexed sequences; Map supports arbitrary keys; Set models uniqueness.

callouts.title: Prototype-Safe Dictionaries
callouts.text: Use Map for dynamic key collections or Object.create(null) when a plain string-key dictionary must have no prototype.

subtopics.title: Control Flow & Error Boundaries
subtopics.description: Use guard clauses and exhaustive domain checks. Throw Error objects with causes and catch only where recovery or context is possible.

subtopics.title: Functions, Closures & this
subtopics.description: Closures retain lexical bindings. Arrow functions capture this lexically; method calls bind this from the call site.

callouts.title: Avoid Accidental Receiver Loss
callouts.text: Passing object.method as a callback loses its receiver. Wrap it or bind explicitly when the method uses this.

subtopics.title: Classes, Prototypes & Private Fields
subtopics.description: Class syntax builds on prototypes. Composition and small interfaces usually scale better than deep inheritance; #fields provide runtime privacy.

subtopics.title: ES Modules & Package Boundaries
subtopics.description: Use explicit imports/exports, avoid circular initialization, and expose a small stable package surface through exports maps.

callouts.title: Dynamic Import Inputs Need an Allowlist
callouts.text: Never build module or file paths directly from untrusted input.

subtopics.title: Promises, async/await & Cancellation
subtopics.description: Promises represent eventual settlement. async/await improves sequencing but does not make work cancellable; pass AbortSignal through every supporting layer.

callouts.title: Cancellation Must Be Propagated
callouts.text: Creating an AbortController is not enough. Every cancellable API and wrapper must receive and forward the same signal.

callouts.title: Choose the Correct Promise Combinator
callouts.text: Promise.all fails fast, allSettled preserves every outcome, race settles on the first result, and any resolves on the first fulfillment.

subtopics.title: Iterators, Generators & Async Iteration
subtopics.description: Iterator protocols decouple traversal from storage. Generators implement lazy state machines; for await consumes asynchronous iterables with backpressure per item.

subtopics.title: DOM, Events & Client Storage
subtopics.description: Delegate events where useful, clean up listeners, prefer semantic DOM, and treat browser storage as untrusted persistence.

callouts.title: Never Put Secrets in Browser Storage
callouts.text: localStorage and IndexedDB are accessible to same-origin scripts. Prevent XSS and keep durable credentials in appropriately protected mechanisms.

subtopics.title: Testing & Dependency Boundaries
subtopics.description: Test observable behavior, inject clocks/network/storage, and use integration tests for browser and server boundaries.

subtopics.title: Performance, Memory & Event Loop
subtopics.description: Measure user-visible latency, long tasks, allocations, layout, network waterfalls, and retained listeners before memoizing or micro-optimizing.

callouts.title: Yield Long Work
callouts.text: Split CPU-heavy browser work, move suitable computation to Web Workers, virtualize large lists, and avoid layout thrashing.

subtopics.title: Security & Production Checklist
subtopics.description: Encode output by context, avoid eval-like APIs, validate inputs, pin dependencies, restrict capabilities, and deploy a strong Content Security Policy.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Use strict mode through ESM, handle rejected promises, propagate AbortSignal, bound concurrency, remove listeners, audit dependencies, and test supported runtimes.
